attributes.name: Frost Longbow +1
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill plus your Strength die + 1; you may additionally discard this card to add another 1d6 and the Cold trait. If not proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4.

If proficient with weapons, discard this card to add 1d4+1 and the Cold trait to a combat check by a character at another location.
